## CV formats by country

### Pakistan — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/pakistan

Pakistan CV format: name matching CNIC, Father's Name, Matric / FSc / Higher Secondary School Certificate, Bachelor's or Master's with years, single-column ATS layout. 1 page for freshers, up to 2 pages for experienced candidates.

A CV Maker Pakistan tool should match what Pakistani employers expect: your full name exactly as on your CNIC, your Father's Name, clear education with passing years, and a single-column layout that ATS software can read.

This free CV Maker Pakistan builder needs no sign-up and adds no watermark. Build your CV in your browser, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your CV stays on your device.

#### What to include in a Pakistani CV

Start with your full name (as on your CNIC), Father's Name, phone, email and city. Then add a short professional summary, work experience with results, education, skills and, only if asked, references.

For education, write Matriculation, then FSc / ICS / A-Levels (Higher Secondary School Certificate), then your Bachelor's or Master's degree with institution and passing year. Recruiters in Pakistan check these lines first.

#### CV format Pakistan: length and layout

Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates should usually keep the CV to 1 page. Candidates with several years of experience may use 2 pages. Use one column, standard headings (Experience, Education, Skills) and real bullet points.

Do not use two columns, text boxes or tables for key details. ATS parsers can read them out of order, and your experience can end up under the wrong heading.

#### Pakistani CV template: free download as PDF

There is no separate file to download. Build your CV with the free builder, preview it live, then choose Print to PDF in your browser to save a print-ready PDF. That is the Pakistani CV template free download most job seekers need.

Submit the PDF unless the employer asks for Word (.doc / .docx). PDF keeps your formatting the same on every device.

Key rules: Name must match CNIC + Father's Name; Matric, FSc / HSSC, degree with years; 1 page freshers, 2 pages experienced.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Is CV Maker Pakistan free?
A: Yes. CV Maker Pakistan is free to use online. There is no sign-up and no watermark. You build your CV in your browser and use Print to PDF to save it.

Q: What should a Pakistani CV include?
A: Include your full name matching your CNIC, Father's Name, contact details, education (Matriculation, FSc / Higher Secondary School Certificate, Bachelor's or Master's with passing years), work experience, skills, and references if asked. Keep it single-column with standard headings so ATS software can read it.

Q: How long should a CV be in Pakistan?
A: Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates should usually keep it to 1 page. Candidates with several years of experience may use 2 pages. Every line should support the job you want.

Q: Should I add a photo to a Pakistani CV?
A: A photo is not required for most private-sector jobs in Pakistan. Add one only if the job advertisement asks for it. Keep the rest of the CV clean and ATS-friendly either way.

### United States — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/usa

Single-column chronological format focused heavily on core technical skills, metrics, and modern ATS parsers.

A US resume template (USA CV) follows a simple rule: show results, not duties. Recruiters scan for a strong summary, recent experience with numbers, and skills that match the job posting.

Build your US resume free in the browser with no sign-up and no watermark, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your data stays on your device.

#### US resume format

Use a single-column, reverse-chronological layout. Start with a 2-3 line summary, then Experience, Skills and Education. Keep it to 1 page early in your career and up to 2 pages with more experience.

Leave out your photo, date of birth, marital status and full street address. US employers do not expect them, and they add nothing to your application.

#### Write bullets with metrics

Each bullet should show an action and a result: what you did, and what changed. Add numbers where you honestly can — revenue, users, time saved, or percentage improvements.

Mirror the exact skill names from the job posting where they truthfully describe your work. That helps both ATS keyword matching and the human reader.

#### US resume template: Word, PDF and Google Docs

Many job seekers search for a US resume template in Word or Google Docs. This builder gives you the same result without a download: build it here, then Print to PDF. A text-based PDF keeps your formatting identical everywhere.

Submit the PDF unless the employer asks for .docx. If they ask for Word, print to PDF first to check the layout, then export from your document tool.

#### US resume keywords: match the posting, honestly

A US resume format works best when its skills and job titles mirror the posting you are applying for. Recruiters and ATS software both scan for the exact skill names in the ad — programming languages, tools, certifications — so use the posting's own words wherever they truthfully describe your work.

Do not paste a block of keywords at the bottom of the page. Instead, weave each skill into a real bullet or the skills section, with a result attached. A keyword with no evidence behind it hurts you in the interview, even if it helps you pass a filter.

Key rules: No photo or DOB required; Focus on ROI & metrics; 1-2 page limit.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Should a US resume include a photo?
A: No. US resumes do not include a photo, date of birth or marital status. Leave them out and use the space for experience and results.

Q: How long should a US resume be?
A: Usually 1 page early in your career and up to 2 pages with substantial experience. Cut older or irrelevant roles before adding a third page.

Q: Is a US resume template in Word or PDF better?
A: A text-based PDF is usually best because formatting stays the same. Use .docx only when the employer asks for it.

Q: What is the best US resume format for ATS?
A: A single-column, reverse-chronological resume with standard headings (Summary, Experience, Skills, Education) and real bullet points. Avoid two-column layouts and text boxes.

Q: Is a US resume the same as a CV?
A: In the United States, a resume is the standard 1-2 page job document. A CV in the US is mostly used in academia and research and can run much longer. For almost every US job application, employers expect a resume, not a CV.

### United Kingdom — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/united-kingdom

Formal UK CV structure highlighting academic credentials, professional memberships, and targeted achievements.

A UK CV template is more formal than a US resume. Employers expect a clear personal statement, detailed employment history, education and professional memberships — usually across 2 pages.

Build your UK CV free in the browser with no sign-up and no watermark, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your data stays on your device.

#### UK CV format

Open with your name, contact details and a short personal statement (3-4 lines) that names the role you want and your strongest evidence. Then list employment history from newest to oldest, followed by education and skills.

Keep it to a 2-page maximum in most cases. Recruiters in the UK expect depth, but they still scan quickly — put your strongest, most relevant experience first.

#### What to leave out

Do not add a personal photo, date of birth or marital status. UK employers do not expect them. Keep your address to city and postcode, plus phone and email.

Avoid creative headings such as My Journey. Use standard headings — Personal Statement, Employment History, Education, Skills — so ATS software can parse your CV.

#### UK resume template: Word and free download

Many job seekers look for a UK resume template in Word or a free download. This builder gives you the same result without a file download: build it here, then Print to PDF for a print-ready file.

Submit the PDF unless the employer asks for Word. If you need a Word version, keep the same single-column structure when you copy your text across.

Key rules: 2-page maximum standard; No personal photos; Detailed employment history.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Should a UK CV include a photo?
A: No. UK CVs do not include personal photos. Leave the photo out and use the space for your employment history and achievements.

Q: How long should a UK CV be?
A: A 2-page maximum is the standard for most roles. One page can work for students and recent graduates.

Q: What is the difference between a UK CV and a US resume?
A: A UK CV is usually longer (up to 2 pages) and more detailed about education and memberships. A US resume is shorter and more results-focused. Both should be single-column and ATS-friendly.

Q: Is a UK CV template in Word or PDF better?
A: A text-based PDF is usually best because formatting stays the same. Use Word only when the employer asks for it.

### Germany & Austria — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/germany-austria

Detailed chronological structures for a Germany CV and Austria CV, incorporating personal info, clear academic degrees, and skill matrices.

A Germany CV format is formal, complete and chronological. German employers expect personal details, a clear education timeline, work history, skills and, often, a signed and dated CV.

Build your Germany CV free in the browser with no sign-up and no watermark, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your data stays on your device.

#### Germany CV format

Use a clear chronological structure: personal details, professional experience (newest first), education, skills, languages and additional qualifications. Keep dates in one consistent format throughout.

Unlike US resumes, a German CV usually includes a photo, date of birth, nationality and place of birth. Check the job posting — some employers now accept a photo-free CV, but the traditional format still includes these details.

#### Europass and professional tone

Europass is a standard European CV format. It is structured and widely understood, but many German recruiters prefer a well-designed tabular CV with the same information. Either way, keep the tone formal and factual.

List degrees with their full names, institutions and dates. Add a short skills matrix for tools, languages and certifications so a reader can scan your qualifications quickly.

#### Germany CV format: PDF and free download

Job seekers often search for a Germany CV format PDF or free download. This builder gives you the same result without a file download: build it here, then Print to PDF for a clean, print-ready file.

Submit the PDF unless the employer asks for another format. A text-based PDF keeps your layout identical and lets ATS software read your text.

Key rules: Formal layout structure; Structured education timeline; Professional tone.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Does a Germany CV need a photo?
A: Traditionally yes — a professional photo is common on German CVs. Some employers now accept photo-free CVs, so check the posting. The builder lets you decide either way.

Q: Should a Germany CV include date of birth and nationality?
A: Yes, in the traditional German format these details are expected. Keep them in the personal details section at the top.

Q: What is Europass?
A: Europass is a standard European CV format with fixed sections. It is widely understood, but many German recruiters prefer a tailored tabular CV with the same information.

Q: How long should a Germany CV be?
A: Usually 2 pages. Keep it structured and factual — every section should support the role you want.

### Canada — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/canada

Similar to US standards — a Canadian resume with emphasis on work authorization status and Canadian experience equivalence.

A Canada resume template is close to the US format, with extra attention to work authorization and how your international experience maps to Canadian roles.

Build your Canada resume free in the browser with no sign-up and no watermark, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your data stays on your device.

#### Canada resume format

Use a single-column chronological or hybrid layout on standard Letter size. Open with a summary, then Experience, Skills and Education. Keep it to 1-2 pages.

Do not include a photo, date of birth, marital status or SIN number. Canadian employers do not expect them.

#### Work authorization and Canadian experience

If you are authorized to work in Canada, say so briefly in your summary or at the top — for example, authorized to work in Canada. Do not include permit numbers on the resume itself.

For international experience, explain your role in terms a Canadian reader understands: team size, budget, tools and results, rather than local job titles alone.

#### Canada resume template: Word, PDF and free download

Job seekers often look for a Canada resume template in Word or a free PDF download. This builder gives you the same result without a file download: build it here, then Print to PDF.

Submit the PDF unless the employer asks for Word. A text-based PDF keeps your formatting identical and parses cleanly in ATS software.

Key rules: Chronological & hybrid; Action-oriented bullets; Standard Letter size.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Should a Canada resume include a photo?
A: No. Canadian resumes do not include photos, date of birth or marital status.

Q: How long should a Canada resume be?
A: Usually 1-2 pages. Keep it to 1 page early in your career and up to 2 pages with more experience.

Q: Should I mention work authorization on a Canada resume?
A: Yes, a brief line such as authorized to work in Canada helps recruiters. Do not include permit or SIN numbers.

Q: Is a Canada resume template in Word or PDF better?
A: A text-based PDF is usually best. Use Word only when the employer asks for it.

### Japan — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/japan

Clean, structured formats for a Japanese CV, aligned with Japanese corporate recruitment standards and biographic precision.

A Japan CV format values precision and structure. Employers expect a clear personal background, exact dates, detailed career history and a formal, professional layout.

Build your Japan CV free in the browser with no sign-up and no watermark, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your data stays on your device.

#### Japan CV format

Use a clean, structured layout with exact dates for every role and qualification. List education and work history in chronological order with no gaps left unexplained.

Keep the tone formal and factual. Japanese recruiters value completeness and accuracy over creative design — a tidy, consistent CV beats a flashy one.

#### Personal background and career history

Include your personal background, contact details, education, career history, qualifications, skills and languages. For each role, state your responsibilities and concrete results.

If you are applying in English, keep job titles and company names in the form the employer will recognize, and add a short note where a local term needs explanation.

#### Japan CV format: PDF and free download

Key rules: Clear personal background; Detailed career history; Professional layout.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Should a Japan CV include a photo?
A: A professional photo is common on Japanese CVs, especially for traditional rirekisho-style applications. For English-language applications, follow the employer's instructions.

Q: How detailed should a Japan CV be?
A: More detailed than a US resume. List exact dates, full career history and qualifications with no unexplained gaps.

Q: Is a Japan CV format in English acceptable?
A: Yes, for international roles and foreign companies in Japan. For domestic Japanese companies, a Japanese rirekisho may be expected — check the posting.

Q: Is a Japan CV format in Word or PDF better?
A: A text-based PDF is usually best. Use Word only when the employer asks for it.

### Sweden — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/sweden

Minimalist, modern layouts for a Swedish CV, focusing on transparency, teamwork competencies, and balanced lifestyles.

A Sweden CV format is minimalist and honest. Swedish employers value a concise summary, teamwork, and experience they can verify — not long lists of buzzwords.

Build your Sweden CV free in the browser with no sign-up and no watermark, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your data stays on your device.

#### Sweden CV format

Keep it concise: a short summary, experience with concrete results, education, skills and languages. One to two pages is the norm.

Use clean ATS headings — Summary, Experience, Education, Skills — and a single column. Swedish recruiters scan quickly and appreciate white space.

#### Teamwork and verifiable experience

Show how you worked with others: team size, shared goals and what the team achieved. Swedish workplaces value collaboration, so teamwork evidence matters.

Keep every claim verifiable. Swedish employers often check references, so only list experience and results you can back up.

#### Sweden CV: photo or not?

A photo is not required on a Sweden CV. Most candidates leave it out. Use the space for a stronger summary and better bullets.

If you do add a photo, keep it professional and small. The layout must stay single-column and ATS-friendly either way.

Key rules: Concise summary; Clean ATS headings; Verifiable experience.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Should a Sweden CV include a photo?
A: No, a photo is not required on a Sweden CV. Most candidates leave it out.

Q: How long should a Sweden CV be?
A: Usually 1-2 pages. Keep it concise and focused on relevant experience.

Q: What style suits a Sweden CV?
A: Minimalist and modern: clean headings, generous white space, concrete results and evidence of teamwork.

Q: Is a Sweden CV template in Word or PDF better?

Gulf CVs are often 2 pages. Use a single column with standard headings so ATS software can read your experience correctly.

#### Credentials and mega projects

List degrees, licences and certifications with full names and dates. For project roles, show the project, your role, scale (budget, team, timeline) and the outcome.

If you worked on Vision-aligned or giga-project work, say so plainly. Recruiters search for that experience.

#### Saudi Arabia CV format: PDF, Word and for nurses

Job seekers often search for a Saudi Arabia CV format PDF, in Word, or for nurses. The structure is the same: build it here, then Print to PDF for a clean file. Submit the PDF unless the employer asks for Word.

For nursing roles, add your licence, registration and clinical areas clearly. Gulf hospitals check credentials before shortlisting.

Key rules: Detailed credentials; Large-scale projects; Formal profile header.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: Should a Saudi Arabia CV include a photo?
A: A professional photo is common on Saudi CVs. Keep it small and professional if you add one.

Q: Should a Saudi Arabia CV include nationality and visa status?
A: Yes. Gulf employers expect nationality and visa / work status on the CV.

Q: What should a Saudi Arabia CV format for nurses include?
A: Licence and registration, clinical areas, hospital experience, and certifications — with dates. Keep the same single-column, ATS-friendly structure.

Q: Is a Saudi Arabia CV format in Word or PDF better?
A: A text-based PDF is usually best. Use Word only when the employer asks for it.

### Australia — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/australia

#### Australia CV format

Open with a short profile, then Key Skills or Competencies, Employment History, Education and Referees. Use a single column with standard headings.

Australian employers expect detail: what you did, how you did it, and what changed. Use the extra space for evidence, not filler.

#### Competencies and referees

Show competencies with short examples: the situation, what you did, and the outcome. That is what Australian recruiters read for.

End with referees (name, role, organisation, phone/email) or Available on request. If you list referees, confirm they are willing to be contacted.

### India — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/india

India CV format: reverse-chronological resume, 1 page for freshers and up to 2 pages for experienced candidates, CGPA with scale, Class X and XII for freshers, skills and projects first. Free ATS-friendly builder, no sign-up, Print to PDF.

Indian recruiters and campus drives expect a reverse-chronological resume: your latest role or project first, then earlier ones, then education and skills. Freshers keep it to one page; experienced candidates may use two.

This free builder needs no sign-up and adds no watermark. Build your India CV format in your browser, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your CV stays on your device.

#### India CV format for freshers

Freshers should lead with skills and projects, not education alone. List programming languages, tools and frameworks, then academic and internship projects with measurable outcomes — users reached, marks improved, time saved.

Include Class X and XII percentages with board and year, because many campus recruiters set minimum eligibility marks. Add degree, college, CGPA with its scale (for example 8.4/10), internships, certifications such as NPTEL, AWS or Google, and a short career objective only if it names the role you want.

#### India CV format: length, photo and declaration

One page suits freshers and early-career roles; two pages are common once you have several years of relevant experience. A photo is optional — most private employers do not need one, so leave it out unless the employer or placement cell asks for it.

A declaration is not needed for most private companies, but government, PSU and some traditional employers still expect one line with place, date and your name. Never put current or expected CTC on the resume; share it on the application form or when the recruiter asks.

#### India CV template: Naukri, campus drives and PDF

Recruiters search Naukri, LinkedIn India and Apna by skills and job titles, so match your skills section to the posting honestly and keep standard headings (Summary, Skills, Projects, Experience, Education). Avoid tables, text boxes and creative two-column layouts for ATS campus drives; single-column text parses cleanly.

Save a text-based PDF named Firstname-Lastname-Resume.pdf unless the portal asks for Word. PDF keeps your formatting identical on every device, which matters when a recruiter opens it on a phone.

Key rules: Reverse-chronological: latest job first; 1 page freshers, up to 2 pages experienced; CGPA with scale; Class X and XII for freshers.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: What is the best CV format for India?
A: Reverse-chronological: latest job first, then earlier roles, then education and skills. One page for freshers, up to two pages for experienced candidates.

Q: Should freshers include Class X and XII marks?
A: Yes. Many campus recruiters set minimum Class X and XII percentages, so give board, year and percentage for both.

Q: Do I need a photo or declaration on an Indian CV?
A: A photo is optional for most private employers; add one only if asked. A declaration is expected mainly by government and PSU employers, not by most private companies.

Q: Is India CV format PDF or Word better?
A: A text-based PDF is best for most applications. Use Word only when the portal or employer asks for it.

### Bangladesh — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/bangladesh

Bangladesh CV format: corporate structure with career summary, skills, experience, projects, education and references on request. 1 page for freshers, 2 pages up to 10 years of experience. Free builder, no sign-up, Print to PDF.

Bangladeshi corporate employers expect a clear, formal CV: a short career summary, skills matched to the job, experience with results, education with years, and references only when asked.

This free builder needs no sign-up and adds no watermark. Build your Bangladesh CV format in your browser, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your CV stays on your device.

#### Bangladesh CV format: structure that employers expect

Start with name, mobile, professional email, city and a LinkedIn or portfolio link. Follow with a career summary rewritten for the role, skills supported by evidence, experience with dates and achievements, projects for freshers and technical roles, then education and training.

Traditional Bangladeshi CVs also list personal details such as father's name, date of birth and nationality. For modern corporate and multinational roles, keep personal details short and put the focus on skills and results instead.

#### Bangladesh CV format: how many pages

Freshers and early-career candidates should aim for 1 page. Candidates with up to about 10 years of experience commonly use 2 pages, and very senior candidates may use 3. Put the most important information on page one, because a busy recruiter may never reach page three.

Use one column and standard headings so the CV reads cleanly in print and in applicant tracking systems. Save as PDF unless the employer asks for a Word file.

#### Bangladeshi CV format Word file and PDF

Many job seekers search for a Bangladeshi CV format Word file. This builder gives you something better than a fixed file: a live template you can edit, preview and print to PDF whenever your experience changes.

Name the file clearly, for example CV_Name_Designation_Years, so recruiters can find it later. Keep the formatting simple — no heavy shading or graphics that print badly.

Key rules: Career summary, skills, experience, education; 1 page freshers, 2 pages up to 10 years; References only when the employer asks.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: What is the best CV format for Bangladesh?
A: A formal corporate format: career summary, skills, experience with results, projects, education, and references only when asked.

Q: How many pages should a Bangladesh CV be?
A: 1 page for freshers, 2 pages for up to about 10 years of experience, 3 pages only for very senior candidates.

Q: Should I include personal details like father's name?
A: Traditional formats include them, but modern corporate roles prefer a short personal section focused on contact details, skills and results.

Q: Is Bangladesh CV format PDF or Word better?
A: PDF is best for most applications because formatting stays identical. Use Word only when the employer asks for it.

### Sri Lanka — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/sri-lanka

Sri Lanka CV format: 1-2 page A4 CV, single-column, with summary, experience, education, professional qualifications, skills and languages, and two non-related referees. Free builder, no sign-up, Print to PDF.

Sri Lankan employers expect a one or two page A4 CV in a single column: contact details, professional summary, work experience with achievements, education, professional qualifications, skills and languages, and two non-related referees.

This free builder needs no sign-up and adds no watermark. Build your Sri Lanka CV format in your browser, then use Print to PDF to save it. Your CV stays on your device.

#### Sri Lanka CV format for freshers

Freshers and school leavers should keep the CV to one page with education first: degree or diploma, then A/L stream and results, followed by projects, internships, part-time work, leadership in societies or sports, and skills.

Write internships and projects with results, the same way an experienced candidate writes a job. A short line about what you built or improved matters more than a long list of duties.

#### Sri Lanka CV format: referees, NIC and photo

Two non-related referees are standard in Sri Lanka: a former manager, supervisor or lecturer with designation, organisation, phone number and email. Ask their permission before you list them, or write References available on request if you prefer.

Your NIC number, date of birth, civil status and religion are not needed for most private sector applications. Add them only when the employer or application form asks, which is common for government posts and some banks. A photo is optional and rarely helps; leave it out unless the advertisement asks for one.

#### Sri Lanka CV template: PDF and length

One page suits students and fresh graduates; two pages suit most professionals; three pages only for senior specialists or executives with long careers. Put the strongest evidence on page one.

Save as Firstname-Lastname-CV.pdf after a careful proofread. A clean single-column layout also reads well in applicant tracking systems used by banks, IT companies and multinationals.

Key rules: 1 page freshers, 2 pages professionals; Two non-related referees are standard; NIC only when the employer asks.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: What is the best CV format for Sri Lanka?
A: A one or two page A4 CV in a single column: contact, summary, experience with achievements, education, qualifications, skills, languages and two referees.

Q: Do I need referees on a Sri Lankan CV?
A: Yes. Two non-related referees are standard. Include their designation, organisation, phone and email, with their permission.

Q: Should I include my NIC number or photo?
A: Only when asked. NIC is common for government posts and some banks. A photo is optional and rarely helps for private sector roles.

Q: How many pages should a Sri Lanka CV be?
A: One page for students and freshers, two pages for most professionals, three only for senior specialists.

### China — https://cvmakerpakistan.com/country-templates/china

China CV format for CSC scholarship and university applications: professional 1-2 page CV with an uninterrupted study timeline from senior middle school, research and publications first. Free builder, no sign-up, Print to PDF.

Students applying to Chinese universities and the CSC Chinese Government Scholarship need a professional 1-2 page CV that a professor can read in minutes: education with an uninterrupted timeline, research experience, publications and a clear study direction.

This free builder needs no sign-up and adds no watermark. Build your China CV format in your browser, then use Print to PDF to save it for your CSC and university portals. Your CV stays on your device.

#### China CV format for CSC scholarship

The CSC application asks for a professional CV of 1-2 pages alongside the application form, degree certificates, transcripts, a study plan of at least 1000 words, two recommendation letters and a passport copy. Your CV supports all of these: it must agree with your transcripts and study plan.

Professors deciding on acceptance letters look for research fit first. Put your degree, research projects, publications and the field you want to study in China at the top, before part-time jobs that do not relate to your study plan.

#### China CV format: study experience timeline

Chinese universities ask for a study experience resume whose start and end dates are uninterrupted, beginning from senior middle school. List every stage of education in order with institution, dates and level, and leave no unexplained gaps.

If you studied or worked between degrees, show it in the same timeline. A gap with no explanation is the most common reason a university portal sends an application back for correction.

#### Chinese CV template: language and PDF

Write the CV in English unless the university asks for Chinese. Keep sentences short and factual, and use the same field names as your study plan so a professor can match them in seconds.

Save a text-based PDF and check that it opens cleanly on a phone, because professors often read attachments on mobile first. Use one column and standard headings so nothing is lost when the PDF is printed or parsed.

Key rules: Professional CV, 1-2 pages; Uninterrupted study timeline from senior middle school; Research, publications and study plan focus.

Frequently asked questions:

Q: How many pages should a China CV be for CSC?
A: A professional CV of 1-2 pages. One page suits most applicants; two pages suit applicants with research and publications.

Q: What is a study experience resume for China?
A: An education timeline with uninterrupted start and end dates from senior middle school, matching your transcripts and study plan.

Q: Should a China CV include a photo?
A: This builder does not add photos. A clean, photo-free CV is accepted for CSC and university applications; follow the specific university portal if it asks otherwise.

Q: Is China CV format PDF or Word better?
A: A text-based PDF is best for uploads to CSC and university portals. Use Word only when a portal asks for it.

### Executive Elite
Best for: C-level executives, directors, senior managers. Dark serif header with premium typography for senior leadership roles.

### Modern Impact
Best for: Corporate, marketing, and mid-level professionals. Vibrant color header with bold sections that stand out to recruiters.

### Clean Minimalist
Best for: Design, consulting, and premium industries. Refined typography with generous white space for clean readability.

### Creative Bold
Best for: Designers, marketers, content creators. Expressive layout with dynamic accents and pill-shaped headings.

### Software Engineer Pro
Best for: Developers, DevOps, and data engineers. Monospace design with skills-first layout for technical roles.

### Fresh Graduate
Best for: Students, fresh graduates, entry-level applicants. Education-first layout built for candidates with limited experience.

### Europass Standard
Best for: Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain, and EU markets. Traditional Europass-compliant CV format for European job markets.

### Two-Column Pro
Best for: UX, product, and international professionals. Modern two-column layout with dark sidebar for contact and skills.

### Designer Portfolio
Best for: Designers, product managers, creative leads. Striking sidebar with avatar circle and skill progress bars.

### Slate Professional
Best for: Corporate, finance, and operations roles. Dark slate header with a bold amber rule — a sharp, boardroom-ready US look.

### Midnight Bold
Best for: Marketing, sales, and creative professionals. Black header block with accent bars — high contrast without a photo, fully ATS-readable.

### Ivy Minimal
Best for: Academia, law, consulting, and senior professionals. Centered serif layout with classic rules — quiet, credible, and recruiter-friendly.

### Compact Metrics
Best for: Analysts, engineers, and results-driven roles. Skills strip up top and tight sections that put numbers and outcomes first.

### Heritage Green
Best for: Pakistan, Gulf, and formal markets. Deep green double rule with classic formal sections — a dignified look for Pakistani and Gulf employers.

### Oxford Classic
Best for: UK professionals, law, academia, consulting. Left-aligned serif layout with a burgundy rule — the traditional British CV, polished for modern hiring.

### Berlin Tabular
Best for: Germany, Austria, and structured EU markets. Monochrome tabular layout with letterspaced headings — formal, precise, and easy to scan.
